item.title: Plant Hoarder Snail Slowly Acquiring Greenery

item.title: Sneaky Raccoon Plant Hoarder Just One More Cutting
item.description: A sneaky raccoon clutches a tiny pot with a fresh cutting, swearing it's just one more for the collection. Perfect for plant hoarders and propagation fans, it makes a funny gift on stickers, mugs and tote bags. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Pumpkin Grower Mushroom Sprite Grew One Pumpkin
item.description: A tiny mushroom sprite proudly shows off the one pumpkin it grew, because every harvest counts! A sweet, funny pick for gardeners, plant lovers and anyone who loves cosy autumn vibes. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.
